name: Qwen Multi-Angle
notes: The LoRA was trained on the terse vocabulary the upstream ComfyUI-qwenmultiangle node emits: '<sks> {horizontal} {vertical} {framing}'. This is a TRIGGER PHRASE, not free-form English — rewriting the words breaks the conditioning, and the '<sks>' token must stay. All four vertical bands of that node are here (<-15 / <15 / <45 / >=45 degrees); a port that kept only three lost 'elevated shot'.
